headline: Ukraine's biggest drone attack this year on St. Petersburg'
dek: Ukraine launched >1,000 drones overnight (Russia MoD: 1,015 intercepted across 15 regions); St. Petersburg Oil Terminal and Ruchi oil depot on fire; VK data centre and Ozon logistics hub struck; 1 killed, 15 injured (Reuters) / 1 killed 5 hospitalised (Beglov); Pulkovo airport restricted; 12…
sources: Reuters / Governor Alexander Beglov / Russia MoD / CNN fresh coverage
fault_line: Is Ukraine's deep-strike campaign legitimate pressure on Russia — or reckless escalation that costs it US support?

sections.what_happened: Ukraine launched >1,000 drones overnight (Russia MoD: 1,015 intercepted across 15 regions); St. Petersburg Oil Terminal and Ruchi oil depot on fire; VK data centre and Ozon logistics hub struck; 1 killed, 15 injured (Reuters) / 1 killed 5 hospitalised (Beglov); Pulkovo airport restricted; 12 housing blocks damaged; ~20,000 in Yanino without power. Largest attack on St. Petersburg since 2022 (Leningrad governor). Peskov: Russia's 'systematic and massive' retaliatory strikes continue.
sections.what_verified: Reuters, CNA, Firstpost, BusinessDay(AP-derived), governor statements, Fire Point (drone maker) confirming FP-1 hit on VK data centre
sections.what_disputed: Russia MoD 1,015 interception claim is unilateral and unverifiable; casualty figures differ between Reuters wire (1 killed/15 injured) and Beglov (1 killed/5 hospitalised); CNN 'defies Trump' framing is editorial. An ada-derana aggregator piece conflates this with an old St Petersburg Economic Forum — disregarded.
sections.why_matters: Kyiv's 1,000-drone message: from Iran's neutralized-US-navy posture to Ukraine defying Washington — the energy war is now a war on Trump's diesel deal. Note Rubio denial of deliberate satellite-internet restriction (attributed report, lokmattimes) + Russia struck dry-cargo ship 30km east of Odesa port.
sections.context: Background: Russia/Ukraine — NEW in-window: Ukraine's biggest drone attack this year on St. Petersburg

totw_analysis: Our read: Kyiv's 1,000-drone message: from Iran's neutralized-US-navy posture to Ukraine defying Washington — the energy war is now a war on Trump's diesel deal. Note Rubio denial of deliberate satellite-internet restriction (attributed report, lokmattimes) + Russia struck dry-cargo ship 30km east of Odesa port. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is Ukraine's deep-strike campaign legitimate pressure on Russia — or reckless escalation that costs it US support?
